application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2021.11.006, accepted manuscript p. 3 (valve-regulated lead-acid, 12 V, 6 cells in series)

units_released.note: Rule: one battery per .npz file. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.note: This package is lead-acid; a lithium-ion cell count does not apply.

cells_leadacid.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2021.11.006, accepted manuscript p. 3: each battery 12 V nominal, 6 cells in series

cell_channels_measured.note: Each battery file has one battery voltage; no cell voltages are released.

energy_mwh.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2021.11.006, accepted manuscript p. 3: nominal voltage 12 V, nominal capacity 20 Ah per battery

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from stated configuration

span_unit_years.note: First to last record per battery, summed over all batteries, as released. The release keeps telemetry after the repair date for failed batteries (scripts/checks/aitio_lifetime.py); the paper analysed the data truncated at repair.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.note: 491 batteries entered repair for capacity loss, diagnosed by the operator at repair; meta_data.csv gives the repair date (IN_REPAIR_SYSTEM), not a fault onset. The authors chose the roughly balanced failed/healthy split (p. 22), so it is not a fleet failure rate.

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5287/bodleian:aVR4oDV4N; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
